popCulture.title: Icarius (Athenian)
popCulture.description: Attic host of Dionysus who shared the first wine — murdered by shepherds, mourned by Erigone, and set among the stars.

popCulture.title: Erigone (daughter of Icarius)
popCulture.description: Daughter who finds her father's body and hangs herself — the Aiora rites and Virgo still remember her grief.

popCulture.title: Boötes
popCulture.description: The constellation tradition that places Icarius in the northern sky — wine's first teacher as the celestial herdsman.
